2026-11-28T05:01Z

**L1-a: REWORK** at `ba557beabf`: one should-fix

The face is L1 only. No `packages/spec/src` file is in the diff, the PR declares `Clause-②: no`, and it is not a narrowing. `isUnsetFieldValue` was never reachable from `@object-ui/app-shell`'s one entry, so moving it removes nothing public. `Fixes #38121` is right: the card's corrected premise (7233313649, objectui#6499 Option C) is what this delivers. Both changeset sentences match the diff. CI: 45 success, 13 expected skip, 0 failed.

**S1 (should-fix): a value the parse filled in as a default counts as "holds a value", so rows that were never authored are re-shown with the warning.**

- `rowGate` asks only `isUnsetFieldValue(stored)`, so `false`, `'default'` and every other default the parse wrote read as authored.
- `FieldSchema` declares `multiple: z.boolean().default(false)` (`field.zod.ts`). Built artifacts carry it on every field. For example, `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/order_to_cash.json` (protocol `^19`) has `"multiple": false` 64 times, on `text`, `select`, `textarea` and `date` fields.
- The object form's `fields` record entry gates that row with `visibleWhen: "data.type in ['lookup']"` (`object.metadata-form.ts`, line 390). It is drawn by the `RecordField` site this PR changes.
- Failure: open any built object in the object form and expand a `text` field. The `Multiple` row comes back with "Not in effect … saving may be refused because of it" and a Clear value button. The author never wrote that value, and the schema accepts it on every type. The same happens on nearly every non-lookup field of every built object.
- The same shape probably applies to the page form's `template` row (`visibleWhen: "data.type != 'list'"`, `PageSchema` `template: ….default('default')`), wherever a list page is served parsed. Please measure it rather than take my reading.
- Why the tests miss it: case (c) uses a hook whose gated keys have no default. No case draws a record entry holding a parse default. The 8740-test run is silent because no existing test asserted that no notice appears.
- Direction: the JSON schema for the row is already at hand (`props[key]`, and `pickSubSchema(schema, 'record', s.field)` in the record site). One fix is a value equal to that schema's `default` gates as `hidden`, which is what the author sees today. Then pin it with a CONTROL case: an artifact-shaped object whose `text` field carries `multiple: false`, expanded in the real object form, with no `schema-form-inactive-retained` note. Please also confirm the ablation still turns (a) red after the fix.

Nits (accepted deviation or follow-up):

- N1: the "98 published rows" figure in the report counts predicates, not rows that would actually re-show. After S1, it is worth saying how many rows hold a non-default value on the served examples.
- N2: `Type Check UI` and the 7 tests that read the spec's `.d.ts` are NOT MEASURED locally. CI is green on both, so CI's reading stands.

A delta review of the fix head by me is owed.

Fix head for L1-a S1 (comment 7234438288): `44d4afeb` (base main 5b8ca361). One commit on top of `ba557bea`.

- **S1, fixed.** `rowGate` now takes the row's JSON schema. A value equal to that schema's declared `default` (structural equality, `sameJsonValue`) gates as `hidden`, the same as an unset key. All three callers pass it: the sectioned `visibleFields` and its row render pass `props[f.field]`, the flat body and `flatFormRowKeys` pass `props[key]`, and the record entry site passes `pickSubSchema(schema, 'record', s.field)`. The PR body's "What changes" first bullet reads `hidden` as "false and unset". Read it as "false and unset or equal to the declared default". The body is otherwise current.
- **Measured before and after, through the real served object and page forms:**
  - A built object's `text` field with the parse-filled `multiple: false`, expanded: 1 notice before, 0 after.
  - The same field with `multiple: true` (not a default, refused on `text`): 1 notice before and after.
  - The page form's `template` row on a parsed list page (`PageSchema` filled `template: 'default'`): 1 notice and the row drawn before, 0 after. The reviewer's reading held.
- **New pin, case (d)**, in `ResourceEditPage.hiddenRowRetained-38121.test.tsx`: the real served object form (`METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY.object` plus the served `object` schema). (d-1) CONTROL: the served `fields` entry schema declares `multiple.default === false`. (d-2) `multiple: false` on a `text` field draws no notice. (d-3) CONTROL: `multiple: true` on a `text` field draws the notice. The file: `Tests  6 passed (6)`.
- **Two ablations on the committed fix** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; each restored to the HEAD blob `f0ff5d8b`, `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - The default line deleted: `1 failed | 7 passed (8)`, (d-2) red.
  - `rowGate`'s final `return 'retained';` changed to `return 'hidden';`: `3 failed | 5 passed (8)`, with (a), (b) and (d-3) red. (a) still turns red.
- **Regression subset:** the 97 `SchemaForm*` / `ResourceEditPage*` test files in `metadata-admin` at `44d4afeb`: `Test Files  97 passed (97)`, `Tests  711 passed (711)`. `eslint` on the two changed files: 0 errors.
- **N1, not measured:** how many served example rows hold a non-default value under a false predicate. The 98 in the report counts predicates. Left as the nit allows.
- **N2:** CI's reading stands, as before.

**L1-a delta: ACCEPT** at `44d4afeb226d43ecd5aaa7133b4fa889f24c90df`, after REWORK 7234438288 at `ba557beabf`

- **S1: closed.** `rowGate` now treats a stored value as `hidden` when it structurally equals the row schema's declared `default`. So the parse-filled `multiple: false` on a built object's `text` field no longer re-shows the row.
- **All four sites get the same schema.**
  - The sectioned filter and its `FieldRow` both read `props[f.field]`, which is the same object the render block calls `propSchema`, so filter and notice cannot disagree.
  - The flat body and `flatFormRowKeys` both read `props[k]`.
  - The record site now resolves `pickSubSchema(schema, 'record', s.field)` before the gate.
- **`sameJsonValue`.** It compares primitives by identity, keeps arrays apart from objects, and compares objects key for key in both directions. That is enough for a JSON `default`.
- **New case (d).** It uses the real object form with the served `object` JSON schema.
  - The first test checks that the served `fields.*.multiple` default is `false`.
  - `multiple: false` on a `text` field draws no notice.
  - A non-default `multiple: true` on the same type is re-shown with the notice.
  - The report's ablations bite both ways: deleting the default line turns (d-2) red; returning `hidden` turns (a), (b) and (d-3) red. The page `template` and `title` notices I asked to have measured went from 1 to 0.
- The fix commit touches only `SchemaForm.tsx` and the test file. The face is unchanged: L1 only, `Clause-②: no`. CI at this head: 45 success, 13 skipped, 0 failed.
- **N1 and N2 stay as nits or follow-ups.** The Tests section of the body does not yet describe (d); the seat folds that in at landing.
